title: Cumulative Product
text: 通道、列或行元素的累积乘积，输入 2 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Rounding mode} 指定舍入模式；{Multiply input along} 指定 Dimension to multiply input along Channels、{Input processing} 指定输入处理 Columns as channels、{Reset port} 指定 Reset type、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Intermediate product}、{Product output}、{Accumulator}、{Output} 输出、{Output Minimum} 指定 Minimum、{Output Maximum} 指定 Maximum、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

params.name: Multiply input along
params.values: Dimension to multiply input along Channels (running product) (default) | Columns | Rows

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 输入处理 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Reset port
params.values: Reset type None (default) | Rising edge | Falling edge | Either edge | Non-zero sample

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on

params.name: Intermediate product
params.values: Intermediate product Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Product output
params.values: Product output Inherit: Same as input (default) | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Accumulator Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Output
params.values: 输出 Inherit: Same as input (default) | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt([],16,0)

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
